page.overview:
What is Hillcrest Academy?

Hillcrest Academy is a small private prep school that is located in the outskirts of Summer Glen, California. All of the students that attend the school live in its dorms. The headmistress of the school was Keri Tate.

On October 31, 1998, the school would be added to the list of locations that serial killer Michael Myers had came to.

He was searching for his sister, Laurie and in the process of trying to kill her and her son, Myers had killed two students (Charles Deveraux and Sarah Wainthrope) and the school guidance counselor, Will Brennan.

After this night, Keri was sent to Grace Andersen Sanitarium after being charged with murder, thus losing her position at Hillcrest Academy.
